short_term_trader.support: Alternating escape-and-reentry expresses failed directional resolution without equating high churn with disorder.
short_term_trader.counterexample: A single failed breakout or mean reversion is common and must not itself become Stage0.
short_term_trader.veto: No count threshold or direct compact-disorder classifier may be frozen from the synthetic examples.

fund_manager.support: Persistent one-side escape and alternating failed resolution describe different path organization while allowing relocation and instability to coexist.
fund_manager.counterexample: Close-only daily geometry cannot claim intraday breakout intent or actor behavior.
fund_manager.veto: Do not create a new peer Stage or weaken P008 relocation.

quant_researcher.support: The frozen synthetic suite is non-degenerate and exactly reproducible without learned thresholds.
quant_researcher.counterexample: Hand-constructed paths do not establish market separability, window optimality or useful prediction.
quant_researcher.veto: No fresh search, threshold selection, candidate grid or qualification claim may follow directly from E.

data_and_evidence_governance.support: Escape/reentry is neutral causal path geometry and should not remain owned by a Stage-specific module if promoted.
data_and_evidence_governance.counterexample: Registering a Stage-specific hidden Fact would duplicate the existing structure.geometry ownership model.
data_and_evidence_governance.veto: No new Fact family or Catalog registration before a separate structure-owned design/contract and synthetic acceptance.

recommended_next_phase.purpose: Design and synthetically qualify a structure-owned B6-PATH envelope escape/reentry extension, migrating neutral semantics out of Stage-specific ownership without registering a Fact or reading market data.
required_outputs: minimal neutral concept set and identities
decision whether the prototype should become formal B6-PATH concepts or remain research-only
